title: Check In Less — Production Trust after Perplexity × Astra
news_context: OpenAI Perplexity × GPT-6 Astra 2026-09-14 — customer account: Perplexity trusts Astra with end-to-end systems; crafts communications, edits real-world systems, and monitors production software; checks in much less frequently than with earlier models; Johnny Ho, Cofounder and Chief Strategy Officer; better code-writing improves Perplexity search programs that query the web and internal information and summarize concisely; the real challenge is applying informational aspects to real-world systems; useful application is asking Astra to build a small testing program around an application; the model generates realistic stand-in responses for services such as a language-model API or a connector and exercises the workflow end to end; official text has no error rates, time-saved figures, incident counts, or approval table (https://openai.com/index/perplexity-improving-accuracy-with-astra/)

Production-trust / end-to-end-agent-systems lens: the question is whether the remaining check-in inherits a gate after the interval thins; trust here is a customer judgment, not a measured error rate; communications, software edits, and production monitoring share a sentence and not a blast radius; a model-written stand-in test is not an independent referee; a thinner check-in is a capacity claim, not a removed gate; search-quality gains are not production-edit evidence
